content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-16|Cloudflare Webhook-Driven]]-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-7|cloudflare]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-13|COREMERCH guide to payments]] for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Stripe operates in 46 countries, leaving the vast majority of the world without access to its services. PayPal, while more widespread, can suspend accounts and hold funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle provide platforms that also exclude significant markets. Each of these options presents a superficial solution but lacks the underlying architecture necessary for true sovereignty and reliability, especially in regions facing economic instability.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have stringent policies that effectively exclude many creators in Africa, Asia, and Latin America. These policies create a commerce infrastructure that is inaccessible to millions. In contrast, sovereign commerce tools like the Edge Commerce Stack allow creators from these regions to establish their own digital storefronts without the constraints of geographic restrictions. This means you can build, own, and operate your business free from the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processing through Stripe and PayPal can often be slow, especially for creators in restricted countries. In contrast, NOWPayments, integrated with the Edge Commerce Stack, allows for near-instant payment confirmations through various cryptocurrencies with a minimal 0.5% fee. This not only ensures faster access to funds but also avoids the hidden costs associated with currency conversion and bank fees that conventional platforms impose.
Sovereign commerce means complete ownership of your business.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When using traditional platforms, you may think you own your products, but the reality is that the platform controls the delivery and payment processes. With sovereign infrastructure, such as the Edge Commerce Stack, you retain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data. Automated payment verification and file delivery streamline the entire process, allowing you to focus on creating rather than worrying about platform constraints.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're situated in a restricted country and want to sell presets or other digital products, the Edge Commerce Stack is your best option. Deployed in just 48 hours, this stack provides you with full ownership and control over your commerce setup. Unlike platforms that can suspend your account at any time, this infrastructure gives you the freedom to operate independently.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Avoid the risks of account suspension with traditional platforms.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
